ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 80-85% high-intensity white pixels across the medial surface and 15-20% low-intensity black pixels concentrated on the trailing edges and peduncle insertion.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black border along the entire trailing edge; large irregular black pigmentation cluster at the ventral-peduncle junction; multiple discrete dark circular spots (mottling) scattered across the high-intensity white field of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a measured internal angle of approximately 52 degrees and a vertical depth extending approximately 4% into the visible fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels; serrations are more frequent and jagged on the distal ends of the lobes compared to the medial sections.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a generally linear trajectory with a slight convex curvature towards the distal tips; the far-left lobe tip shows a distinct downward-hooking geometric profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of high-contrast circular pixel clusters (rosette scars) visible; highest density on the right lobe; multiple individual white-on-black and dark-on-white circular markings consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible on the medial-left white surface, oriented diagonally towards the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rosettes) across both lobes; irregular, jagged indentation on the far-left lobe tip suggesting minor structural tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized occlusion of the lower central fluke area due to high-intensity white water spray and cavitation at the peduncle base.
